title: Panettone French Toast with Caramelized Yam
description: A sweet breakfast recipe combining the flavors of Italy with a smoky twist.
instructions: In a shallow dish, whisk together almond milk, sugar, and cinnamon.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Dip each panettone slice into the milk mixture, coating both sides.
Cook the panettone slices for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Meanwhile, caramelize the yam slices in a separate skillet with a bit of oil.
Serve the French toast with caramelized yam, drizzled with maple syrup.
